text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The fan votes have been tallied, and Grass Wonder has earned a slot in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The showdown with Maruzensky is at hand, and Grass Wonder can barely contain her excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, Maruzensky suffers an injury while training and is forced to withdraw from the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What's more, Grass Wonder learns that Maruzensky had intended the Arima Kinen to be her last race in the Twinkle Series.
